title: Jubilant Croatian Fideo Noodle Bake
description: A flavorful and satisfying pasta bake combining the best of Croatian and Latin American flavors.
instructions: Cook the Jubilant noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Cook the Croatian fideo according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a simmer and let cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked noodles, fideo, and tomato sauce mixture. Stir to combine.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Top the noodle mixture with the Cheddar cheese and Parmesan cheese.
Bake the pasta bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the pasta bake from the oven and let it cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
